scope: Proposition 3.3 of the manuscript “Boundedness and persistence of weakly reversible mass-action systems” (preprints/Boundedness-and-persistence-of-weakly-reversible-mass-action-systems-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 149 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f953bd681c2ddb7d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite weakly reversible mass-action network with positive constant rates, and every x0 ∈ Rd >0, there is a compact convex polytope K ⊂ Rd >0 containing x0 and forward invariant for the mass-action equation. Here forward invariance means that every solution starting in K exists for all forward time and stays in K.
